name: Continuous Order Book Data 1
definition: Data related to the continuous order books for the pre-trade output report.

EntryDateTime.name: Entry Date Time
EntryDateTime.definition: The CTP shall publish the most recent amongst the dates and times of the best bids and offers entered into the order book that participate in the BBO as reported by the data contributors.

CalculationDateTime.name: Calculation Date Time
CalculationDateTime.definition: Date and time of the calculation of the Best Bid and Offer (BBO).

Bid.name: Bid
Bid.definition: Data related to the bid for continuous order books.

Offer.name: Offer
Offer.definition: Data related to the offer for continuous order books.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Major currency unit in which the best bid and offer prices are expressed.
